featured.title: Cicada 3301: the SURE MUN challenge
featured.text: I designed and built an audio-signal challenge for Cicada 3301, a campus-wide cyber-investigation event for IIIT Bangalore students. Teams had to decode a hidden signal and submit a 16-character hex key to unlock the next challenge. There is a playable web version with an answer box and a walkthrough.
